authority: Existing EXPERIMENT_SPEC section 6 six-request/model recording gate; explicit user priority for main P->D->C progression, not an additional exploratory cohort.
known_results: The distinct SGW-ENG-008-LAT-057 redesigned native scene has six independently verified scripted passes. Its original post-trial object-order verification failure and CPU-only recovery remain preserved. No SGW learned request has run at this freeze.
decode_contract: The pinned SGW native backend requires decode_video=True. Do not change its inference configuration to construct a no-decode condition. Retain the input to the unchanged native model.decode call in all six requests; after inference, re-decode the last three retained latents offline. These are decoder calls, not additional model-sampling requests.
reset_contract: Each HTTP request starts after its own acknowledged wrapper reset. The pinned native service has history_length=1 and builds a fresh one-frame sample. All six requests reuse the same retained native image/proprio snapshot; there is no new physical reset, simulator process or behavioral action.
recording_contract: Fsync request intent before each call; retain native HTTP action outputs, native trace, original 33-frame RGB futures, losslessly represented float32/float16/bfloat16 latents, offline redecodes, reset acknowledgements, actual dependencies/configuration and PID attestation. Raw arrays remain on PVC. Preserved native capture viewport evidence remains the actual source scene video, not a learned rollout.
failure_contract: No automatic retry, extra draw, overwrite, adaptive prompt, model setting change or promotion to a behavioral release. Preserve partial output and exact requests-started count on runtime failure. Record nondeterminism and comparisons without manufacturing a pass.
